targetLeakage.explanation: In the dataset, tariff is mathematically identical to labour + toll + miscellaneous (with 0 difference across all rows when missing miscellaneous is 0). Including labour, toll, and miscellaneous as predictive features constitutes target component leakage because post-hoc line-item costs directly sum to the target. To build an honest, leak-free predictive model for predicting tariff before trip execution, labour, toll, and miscellaneous are excluded from the model feature set.
